case_title.reason: Matches the judgment's caption: Satya Narayana Tiwari and Anr v. State of U.P.

number_of_accused.reason: Two accused (husband and mother-in-law) are named as appellants and decided upon.

accused_gender.reason: One accused is the husband (male) and the other the mother-in-law (female), so Mixed is supported.

accused_age.reason: No age is stated for either accused in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: The judgment describes no religious identity for the accused.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation is stated; the husband 'had gone to his shop' but this is not an occupation statement.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No wealth or class of the accused is described; the Rs 4 lakh marriage spend concerns the victim's family.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: The victim is consistently referred to as a woman/young lady and daughter-in-law; Female is supported.

victim_age.reason: Judgment states the deceased was 'aged about 24 years'.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Husband and mother-in-law relationships are explicitly described.

offence_category.reason: The case is a dowry death under IPC s.304-B.

statutory_provisions.reason: Convictions are recorded under s.304-B, s.498-A IPC and s.4 Dowry Prohibition Act; the judgment supports these.

weapon.reason: Half-burnt cloth with knot used as ligature and kerosene for burning are both described.

evidence_type.reason: Judgment describes circumstantial evidence, medical evidence, recoveries, witness testimony and the false report.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Strangulation then burning, dowry demand, false suicide report and pre-planning are all noted by the court.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts for the accused are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Judgment states the trial court acquitted both accused.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court convicted and sentenced as stated: life under s.304-B, 3 years under s.498-A, 6 months under DPA s.4.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, upholding the convictions.

offence_finally_established.reason: Court held accused committed offences under ss.498-A and 304-B IPC and s.4 DPA.

imprisonment_type.reason: Life sentence under s.304-B was imposed by High Court and upheld; no death sentence was imposed.

imprisonment_years.reason: Final sentence is life, not a fixed term, so null is appropriate.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned anywhere in the judgment.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary uses role-based references, covers prosecution evidence and reveals no outcome or court proceedings.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory minimum or maximum punishment for s.304-B.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim died, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death by strangulation and burning, 31x7 cm ligature mark and burns are recorded in the post mortem findings.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 3 convicted under IPC s.304-B, IPC s.498-A and DPA s.4 (charge list not set out); 3 finally upheld
number_of_offences.quote: The accused are established to have committed the offences under Sections 498-A and 304 B IPC and under Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act
number_of_offences.reason: The 'charged' count is an inference; the judgment does not set out the charges framed, only the convictions.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property was lost; the dowry demand was not satisfied, so Not applicable fits.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court states the crime was committed with preplanning and the phone call was part of a scheme.

motive.reason: Court accepted that dowry demand for a Maruti car persisted and was not satisfied.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Father's and relative's testimony, post mortem, recoveries and the investigating officer's evidence are all relied upon.

witness_credibility.reason: Father and relative found credible; defence sister's testimony rejected as interested; recoveries unchallenged.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Absconding, surrender dates and false police report are accurately recorded as the court noted them.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated in the judgment.

bail_history.reason: Supreme Court granted bail on 27.10.2005 and the bonds were cancelled on dismissal.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date, High Court and Supreme Court dates match; trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel for appellants and respondent State are listed as in the judgment.

investigation_status.reason: FIR, investigation, charge sheet and completed trial are all recorded.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Trial judge's knot finding and the absence of an s.302 charge are both noted by the court.

appeal_history.reason: Trial acquittal, High Court conviction and Supreme Court dismissal are accurately summarised.

prosecution_argument.reason: The judgment does not record the prosecution's arguments in the Supreme Court.

defence_argument.reason: Balwant proximity argument, suicide theory, manipulation contention and telephone-call point are all recorded.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Ingredients of s.304-B, proximity test, s.113-B presumption and mental cruelty are all applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Kunhiabdulla, Bachan Singh and Balwant are all cited in the judgment as stated.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Court explains death could not be imposed without a s.302 charge and upheld the High Court sentence.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The court weighed no mitigating factors for the accused.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Barbaric nature, social crime character, and false report are weighed by the court as stated.

other_sentence_order.reason: Bail bonds cancelled and custody ordered; the impleadment allowance is omitted but minor.
